# QualifiedLeadsX
> QualifiedLeadsX is a done-for-you client acquisition agency that builds and runs Meta ads, funnels, CRM and AI follow-up to book qualified sales calls for agency owners, high-ticket coaches and B2B service businesses doing $10,000+ a month. Operated by Ecom Expertz LLC (Sheridan, Wyoming, USA).

Key facts:
- $50M+ managed in Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads; 12+ years experience
- 125+ documented client case studies across 30+ niches, including 69 video breakdowns
- 90-day written guarantee: if mutually agreed growth milestones are not reached within 90 days, work continues with no management fee until they are
- Two plans, both custom quotes: Meta Ads Management, and Full-Service Growth (ads, 3 to 5 page funnel, 40 to 100+ creatives, AI follow-up, email and SMS nurture, lead qualification, CRM and calendar booking)
- Clients own all assets: ad account, funnels, CRM, automations, creatives and data
- Serves the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia
- Contact: hello@qualifiedleadsx.com; free 30-minute strategy call at https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/book-your-call

## Services
- [Lead generation agency for high-ticket offers](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/): the complete done-for-you client acquisition system
- [Meta ads agency](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/meta-ads-agency): Facebook and Instagram ads management for coaches, agencies and B2B
- [Appointment setting](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/appointment-setting): AI follow-up, speed to lead, qualification and calendar booking
- [All services](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/services): overview of every service below
- [Lead generation agency](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/lead-generation-agency): how the done-for-you lead generation engagement works
- [High-ticket lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/high-ticket-lead-generation): lead generation for $3,000 to $25,000 offers
- [B2B lead generation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/b2b-lead-generation): pipeline for B2B service contracts
- [AI speed to lead](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/speed-to-lead): automated response to new leads in under 5 minutes
- [VSL funnels](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/vsl-funnels): video sales letter funnel build and testing
- [WhatsApp lead nurture](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/whatsapp-lead-nurture): pre-call WhatsApp follow-up and reminders
- [CRM automation](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/crm-automation): pipeline, booking and follow-up automation
- [Outsourced sales closers](https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/outsourced-sales-closers): closers for qualified strategy calls

## Who it serves
- Agency owners, high-ticket coaches and consultants, B2B service firms and B2B SaaS selling offers of roughly $3,000 to $25,000 and doing $10,000+ a month
- Industry pages: https://www.qualifiedleadsx.com/for (18 industries, plus Meta ads and appointment setting pages for specific industries)
- Countries: United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia, served remotely. There is no local office in these markets; the registered address is in Sheridan, Wyoming, USA.
